ModMetaData.name: The Sovereignty - Fines & Inspection Options
ModMetaData.author: Dibolic
ModMetaData.description:
Companion mod for "The Sovereignty - A Faction Expansion".
- Pay a fine (within one day) to avoid the warning issued after an inspection. The fine depends on the infractions found and their number. - Configurable fine scale per category (per element or fixed), with the option to exclude a category from inspections. - Option to disable inspections entirely. - If the faction became a permanent enemy: pay an exceptional fine through the comms console to clear all warnings and lift the hostility.
All options are in Options > Mod settings.
